_about: Every test that can skip itself, and the CI job that meets its condition and runs it (issue 1536). Checked by scripts/skip-guards.mjs. A new guard needs an entry here; 'manual' says why no job runs it and how to run it by hand.

entries.how: README_SCREENSHOTS=1 npx playwright test tests/readme-screenshots.spec.ts --project=chromium (from apps/web)
